summary: Fast focused independent review of the updated Release Intelligence v2.0.0-GA GOLDEN BUILD ZIP SHA256 a9dc45795ea194a0f9fe2cdb6ce820e2ca93d1eadf44e3689b28e920230a3a7e. All 29 packaged files byte-match source. Numeric validation now removes commas only from valid thousands-group strings without floating-point conversion, fixing the reproduced comma-list and large-integer conflation. Monthly AI previews require an explicit pinned/click request; hover cannot generate them. Harmless formatting/third-person normalization remains subject to factual checks, while bounded rejected text is escaped, labeled not applied/saved, and kept separate from the editor. The first four metric tiles retain whole-tile filtering without footer links; coverage and story-point bars, larger health ratios, and blue/teal styles preserve underlying values. Collapse-all closes nested groups and epic details. Independently executed three targeted formatting/numeric regressions successfully; no broad/full suite was run. No blocking issues remain. Overall application risk remains High under the existing rubric assessment.
caveats: Normalization and factual/status validation remain linguistic safeguards, not proof of complete grounding. Numeric presence alone does not establish units, achieved outcomes, or relevance; human source review remains necessary.
Rejected generated text is intentionally visible for diagnosis but has not passed validation and is not applied or saved. It must not be treated as an approved leadership update.
Valid plain prose can be accepted with missing citation metadata or omitted prior context; visible validation notes identify those limitations for review.
Explicit AI Preview can still invoke a model; only the source Summary control is cached source-only. Automatic model work on hover is disabled.

Existing Slack prepare/copy-only and unverified native paste/identity behavior, rich-text ordering limits, usage completeness, cache/cancellation, refresh concurrency, journal growth, non-atomic updates, preference semantics, host/catalog/history limits, sharing, and unavailable live list-column metadata caveats remain.

This was a fast focused source/artifact review with three independently executed targeted tests. The implementing agent reported six targeted Node tests passed; the combined UI/AI browser check was still running at review time. Actual native/SDK production-model behavior and hosted-browser behavior were not independently verified; no full suite was rerun.
